text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report provides the results of a 30 km/h speed limit warrant analysis conducted on Sunnypoint Crescent. A 30 km/h speed limit on Sunnypoint Crescent is justified since the measured operating speeds are consistent with a posted speed of 30 km/h and it meets the requirements of City Policy. Currently, this street has an unposted speed limit of 50 km/h.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 30 km/h on Sunnypoint Crescent, between Brooklawn Avenue (north intersection) and Eastville Avenue.
